| **Ashri Legal**   
*(Sunnybank / Southside)* | Client-centred local practice handling Sunnybank and broader Southside matters. | Specialises in property settlements, consent orders, and bespoke Binding Financial Agreements. |

### What to Look for in a Complex Property & BFA Lawyer

- **Asset & Trust Complexity:** If your property pool includes family trusts, corporate entities, commercial holdings, or third-party debt, look for firms that integrate tax or commercial acumen (such as Grasso Searles Romano or national practices with forensic accounting ties).
- **Binding Financial Agreement (BFA) Rigor:** BFAs require strict independent legal advice for both parties under the *Family Law Act 1975* to be legally binding. Ensure the firm you choose routinely drafts airtight agreements to prevent future set-aside applications.
- **Mediation vs. Litigation Track Record:** Most complex matters settle out of court via mediation or collaborative law. Ask prospective firms what percentage of their complex property cases settle prior to a final court hearing.[[1]](https://www.australianfamilylawyers.com.au/cm-family-lawyers-mount-gravatt)
